sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:65510
Court No. - 65
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 58782 of 2022

Applicant :- Maina Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Gunjan Dwivedi,Shri Prakash Dwivedi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Heard Sri S.P. Dwivedi, learned counsel for applicant and Sri Rakesh Kumar Mishra, learned Aga
for State.

2. Applicant-Maina Devi has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking
enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 151 of 2007, under Sections 498A, 304B, 201 Ipc and 3/4
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Mirzapur.
3. In the present case alleged occurrence is dated 01.12.2006.
Daughter-in-law of applicant died in other than normal circumstances.
According to post mortem report immediate cause of death was not ascertained, therefore, Viscera was preserved and as per Viscera report, poisonous substance was found.

Maina Devi vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150247102/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for applicant submits that father-in-law of deceased was initially arrested,
however, applicant and other co-accused remained absconding.
Trial was proceeded against father-in-law and by judgment and order dated 24.03.2012 he was convicted and appeal thereof was filed in High Court.
It is informed that during pendency of appeal, he died.
Learned counsel further submits that applicant and other co-accused remained absconding for a very long time and arrested only on 13.10.2022 and thereafter they are in jail.
He further submits that charges were framed on 23.08.2023, however, thereafter no witness has turned up in pursuance of summons issued by Trial Court for evidence.
Applicant is a lady, aged about 65 years and is in jail since last about one and half years.

5. Learned AGA appearing for State has opposed the prayer for bail and submits that it is a case where applicant and other co-accused remained absconding for a very long time and now trial is proceeded, therefore, bail not be granted.

6. As referred above, applicant and other co-accused remained absconding for a very long time and now after their arrest on 13.10.2022 charges have been framed on 23.08.2023, therefore,
considering that risk of fleeing away still exist, prayer for bail is rejected.

7. However, the application is disposed of with observation that Trial Court concerned shall take all endeavour to conclude trial expeditiously and in case substantial trial is not concluded within a period of six months from today, applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court concerned, as advised, afresh alongwith statute of trial.
8. Registrar (Compliance) to take steps.

Order Date :- 15.4.2024 AK  Maina Devi vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150247102/
